commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: backing image =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/srv-data-backing
sudo -n fallocate -l 3G /var/lib/srv-data-backing/srv_data.img
ls -lh /var/lib/srv-data-backing/srv_data.img

echo "== STEP 2: systemd unit to attach loop device before LVM activation =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop device for srv-data LVM physical volume
DefaultDependencies=no
Before=local-fs-pre.target lvm2-activation.service blk-availability.service
After=systemd-udevd.service
Conflicts=umount.target
Before=umount.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/sbin/losetup /dev/loop20 /var/lib/srv-data-backing/srv_data.img
ExecStop=/sbin/losetup -d /dev/loop20

[Install]
WantedBy=sysinit.target
EOF

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now srv-data-loop.service
losetup -a

echo "== STEP 3: LVM PV/VG/LV =="
sudo -n pvcreate -f /dev/loop20
sudo -n vgcreate srv_data_vg /dev/loop20
sudo -n lvcreate -L 2G -n data srv_data_vg
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f -L srvdata /dev/srv_data_vg/data

echo "== STEP 4: persistent mount =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
UUID=$(sudo -n blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/srv_data_vg/data)
echo "UUID=$UUID /srv/data xfs defaults 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n mount /srv/data
mount | grep /srv/data

echo "== STEP 5: populate application data =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data/app/config /srv/data/app/records
sudo -n sh -c 'cat > /srv/data/app/config/settings.conf <<EOC
service=inventory-api
version=1.4.2
db_host=10.100.104.10
EOC'
sudo -n sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 20); do echo "record-$i,status=active,ts=2026-09-29T07:00:00Z" > /srv/data/app/records/rec-$i.dat; done'
sudo -n chown -R root:root /srv/data
sudo -n find /srv/data -type f | sort
echo "== baseline manifest =="
sudo -n sh -c 'cd /srv/data && find . -type f -exec sha256sum {} \;' | sort -k2 | sudo -n tee /root/srv-data-baseline.sha256
